body:
## Release Notes for 32.6.1

[Windows Installer](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.6.1/draw.io-32.6.1-windows-installer.exe)
[Windows No Installer (zip)](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.6.1/draw.io-32.6.1-windows.zip)
[macOS - Universal](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.6.1/draw.io-universal-32.6.1.dmg)
Linux - [deb](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.6.1/drawio-amd64-32.6.1.deb), [AppImage](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.6.1/drawio-x86_64-32.6.1.AppImage) or [rpm](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.6.1/drawio-x86_64-32.6.1.rpm)

**ChangeLog:**

- Uses electron 44.9.3
- Includes the Electron mitigation for the compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates [GHSA-jr5w-w6x2-84p9]
- Updates to [draw.io core 32.6.1](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/v32.6.1/ChangeLog). All changes from 32.5.5 to 32.6.1 are added in this build.

**Testing:**

Verified against the packaged, signed macOS build. Windows and Linux packages were verified from the produced release artifacts, their sizes and update manifests, rather than by running them.

Base checks

- Launch, open a file passed on the command line, add and edit shapes, change styles, undo and redo, copy and paste through the system clipboard, save, reopen, insert, rename and delete pages, and zoom
- Export to PNG, JPEG, SVG, PDF, XML and HTML from the command line, covering scale, border, transparency, cropping, page selection with -p and --size page, and PNG and PDF export from the app
- Diagram round trip in exported PNG, SVG and PDF files, including reopening an exported PDF and recovering both pages
- Mermaid and CSV import and the --layout and --normalize options from the command line
- Shape search, the stencils and shape palettes, the export dialogs and the print dialog
- Settings and the window position are kept after a restart
- Quick Look preview on macOS is registered for this build, and the Quick Look app extension is sandboxed and separately signed
- The macOS bundle is a universal binary signed with a Developer ID certificate under the hardened runtime, notarised and stapled
- The Electron security fuses are applied, so RunAsNode, the NODE_OPTIONS variable and the node inspect arguments are disabled and the app only loads from the asar
- 286 unit tests pass

Electron 44.9.3

- The app runs on Electron 44.9.3 with Chromium 152.0.7977.167; Electron lists 44.9.1 and later as patched for [GHSA-jr5w-w6x2-84p9]
- Local fonts are listed, and PDF and PNG export through the main process work on the new runtime

Checks around the changes

- Links that start with a slash are kept as they are in SVG exports from the app and from the command line, instead of becoming file:// links [jgraph/drawio#5809]
- Other links in SVG exports are written as before, and javascript: links are still not exported as runnable links
- The updated Citrix 2 shapes render, with no two connection points closer than 8 % of the shape
- The zoom, fit and close buttons of presentation mode respond to mouse clicks
- Reads, stats and writes of paths the user has not authorised are still refused, while an authorised file still reads and saves
- file: and javascript: links are still refused when a link is opened externally
- All update manifests name 32.6.1, with the Windows x64 and arm64 installers in separate manifests

## Release Notes for 32.5.5

[Windows Installer](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.5.5/draw.io-32.5.5-windows-installer.exe)
[Windows No Installer (zip)](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.5.5/draw.io-32.5.5-windows.zip)
[macOS - Universal](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.5.5/draw.io-universal-32.5.5.dmg)
Linux - [deb](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.5.5/drawio-amd64-32.5.5.deb), [AppImage](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.5.5/drawio-x86_64-32.5.5.AppImage) or [rpm](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.5.5/drawio-x86_64-32.5.5.rpm)

**ChangeLog:**

- Uses electron 44.9.0
- Fixes the animated GIF and video export, which failed with "Invalid file data" [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2580]
- Fixes saving libraries, which failed with an error since 31.5.2 [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2581]
- Closes the window when Discard Changes is chosen after a save followed by a quick edit, which kept the window open and stopped every later close and quit from working [jgraph/drawio#5806]
- Updates to [draw.io core 32.5.5](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/v32.5.5/ChangeLog). All changes from 32.4.1 to 32.5.5 are added in this build.

**Testing:**

Verified against the packaged, signed macOS build. Windows and Linux packages were verified from the produced release artifacts, their sizes and update manifests, rather than by running them.

Base checks

- Launch, open a file passed on the command line, add and edit shapes, change styles, undo and redo, copy and paste through the system clipboard, save, insert, rename and delete pages, and zoom
- Export to PNG and PDF from the app, with the diagram embedded and recovered from both files
- Export to PNG, JPG, SVG, PDF, XML and HTML from the command line, covering scale, border, transparency, cropping, page selection with -p, --size page and the embedded diagram
- Diagram round trip in an exported PDF, recovering both pages and their labels
- Mermaid and CSV import and the --layout and --normalize options from the command line
- Shape search, stencils and shape bundles, and the export, animated GIF and print dialogs
- Settings survive a restart
- Paths the user has not authorised are still refused for reads, stats and writes, and file and javascript links are not opened externally
- Quick Look preview on macOS is registered for this build, signed and sandboxed
- The macOS bundle is signed with a Developer ID certificate under the hardened runtime, is notarised and stapled, and the Electron security fuses are applied
- 286 unit tests pass

Animated GIF and video export [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2580]

- GIF87a, GIF89a and MP4 data is written to a file the user chose and reads back byte for byte, where 32.4.1 refused all three with "Invalid file data"
- Other content to the same file is still refused, and so is the same data to a file the user did not choose

Libraries [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2581]

- Three edits to a library in a row are each saved to disk without an error or a dialog

Checks around the changes

- Drafts of unsaved changes are written next to the file and deleted again
- A change to the open file by another program is detected while draw.io is in the background, and replacing the file with an older copy of itself after a save offers to synchronise or overwrite
- Page background gradients appear in PNG, SVG and PDF exports from the command line and drawing scale labels in SVG exports, and a page background that is not a colour loads nothing from the network during export, where 32.4.1 requested it
- PDF exports of a diagram that spans several pages keep the same pages and page sizes as 32.4.1

## Release Notes for 32.4.1

[Windows Installer](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.4.1/draw.io-32.4.1-windows-installer.exe)
[Windows No Installer (zip)](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.4.1/draw.io-32.4.1-windows.zip)
[macOS - Universal](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.4.1/draw.io-universal-32.4.1.dmg)
Linux - [deb](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.4.1/drawio-amd64-32.4.1.deb), [AppImage](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.4.1/drawio-x86_64-32.4.1.AppImage) or [rpm](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.4.1/drawio-x86_64-32.4.1.rpm)

**ChangeLog:**

- Uses electron 44.7.0
- Asks before reading a local file named in Extras > Configuration (libraries, templates or fonts) for the first time, and reads the configuration once when a window opens, so script in the page can no longer make other files on the computer readable by changing it. Files already configured before this update keep working without a prompt
- Reads urlParams.json from the installation folder or the draw.io user data folder only, no longer from the folder draw.io was started in, which on Windows is the folder of a diagram opened from Explorer. A urlParams.json kept elsewhere needs to move to the user data folder (~/Library/Application Support/draw.io on macOS, %APPDATA%\draw.io on Windows). The file can no longer override settings the app manages itself, such as Google Fonts and spell checking
- Takes the value of a short option at the end of a group from the next argument on the command line, so drawio -xf png diagram.drawio exports a PNG instead of looking for an input file named png
- Updates to [draw.io core 32.4.1](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/v32.4.1/ChangeLog). All changes from 32.3.0 to 32.4.1 are added in this build.

**Testing:**

Verified against the packaged, signed macOS build. Windows and Linux packages were verified from the produced release artifacts, their sizes and update manifests, rather than by running them.

Base checks

- Launch, open a file passed on the command line, add and edit shapes, change styles, undo and redo, copy and paste, save, insert, rename and delete pages, and zoom
- Export to PNG, JPEG, SVG, PDF, XML and HTML from the command line, covering scale, border, transparency, cropping, page selection with -p and --size page, and PNG and PDF export from the app
- Diagram round trip in an exported PDF, including reopening the exported PDF and recovering both pages and their contents
- Mermaid and CSV import and the --layout and --normalize options from the command line
- Shape search, stencils and shape libraries, the export dialog and the print dialog
- Drafts of unsaved changes are written next to the file and read back, and saving keeps a backup of the previous version
- A second window opens and reads the files it was given
- Settings survive a restart
- The macOS bundle is signed with a Developer ID certificate under the hardened runtime, is notarised and stapled, and the Quick Look app extension is sandboxed, separately signed and registered for this build
- The Electron security fuses are applied, so RunAsNode, the NODE_OPTIONS variable and the node inspect arguments are disabled and the app only loads from the asar
- 285 unit tests pass

Files named in the configuration

- A library configured in Extras > Configuration on 32.3.0 still loads after the update to this build, without a prompt, on the first and the second launch
- A configured library that was allowed before loads without asking again
- Changing the configuration from script in the page, including every key that can name a file, no longer makes a file readable: reads, stats, writability and existence checks and file watching of that file are all refused, where 32.3.0 returned the file's contents
- Files that are not configured, and system files, stay unreadable

urlParams.json

- A urlParams.json in the folder draw.io is started from is ignored, also when it would hide the editor's open and save functions, where 32.3.0 applied it to every window
- A urlParams.json in the user data folder is applied, and cannot change the Google Fonts or spell checking settings

Command line

- -xf png, -xf png -o file and -xtb 10 -f png export as expected, where 32.3.0 reported an input file named png or 10, and -xfpng still works

Core changes checked in the desktop app

- From Text opened from the search box with Cmd+Enter has the focus in its text box, typing goes into it and Tab stays inside the dialog, where 32.3.0 left the focus on the diagram [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2577]
- The mouse wheel zooms without a modifier, trackpad scrolling does not zoom, Alt with the mouse wheel scrolls, and the zoom hints name Ctrl+Mousewheel
- Containers with the older tree, flow and organic child layouts still arrange their contents, and the older flow, tree and organic layout names in --layout and the CSV tree and organic layouts still lay out the diagram from the command line
- Visio .vsdx files open and convert from the command line as before, and older Visio XML files are refused with a message without being sent anywhere

Checks around the changes

- The functions the app exposes to the editor page are unchanged and give it no access to Node
- Reads, stats and writes of paths the user has not authorised are still refused, while an authorised file still reads and saves
- File and javascript links are still refused rather than opened externally
- Every update manifest names 32.4.1, and the Windows x64 and arm64 manifests each list only their own installer

## Release Notes for 32.3.0

[Windows Installer](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/draw.io-32.3.0-windows-installer.exe)
[Windows No Installer (zip)](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/draw.io-32.3.0-windows.zip)
[macOS - Universal](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/draw.io-universal-32.3.0.dmg)
Linux - [deb](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/drawio-amd64-32.3.0.deb), [AppImage](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/drawio-x86_64-32.3.0.AppImage) or [rpm](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v32.3.0/drawio-x86_64-32.3.0.rpm)

**ChangeLog:**

- Uses electron 44.6.0
- Updates each install type the way it was installed. The Windows installer, macOS and AppImage download updates in the background and show a notice and Help > Restart to Update when one is ready, or install it when you quit. MSI, zip, portable, deb and rpm installs show a notice with a link to the release page instead of running the Windows installer over themselves. Extras > Automatic Updates turns the background checks on and off. Coming from 31.7.0, this update still arrives the previous way [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2569]
- Prints on the printer's own paper size and orientation on macOS, so landscape pages print in landscape on A4 or Letter [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2568]
- Prints pages with a page scale above 100% at full size, they were shrunk a second time since 30.3.11 [jgraph/drawio#5540]
- Adds --embed-svg-metadata to the command line, which adds the properties of shapes and connectors to SVG exports as data-meta-* attributes [jgraph/drawio-desktop#1805]
- Opens the window with the background of the loading screen, which avoids a white flash in dark mode
- Updates to [draw.io core 32.3.0](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/v32.3.0/ChangeLog). All changes from 31.7.0 to 32.3.0 are added in this build.

**Testing:**

Verified against the packaged, signed macOS build. Windows and Linux packages were verified from the produced release artifacts, their sizes and update manifests, rather than by running them.

Base checks

- Launch, open a file passed on the command line, add and edit shapes, change styles, undo and redo, copy and paste, save, insert, rename and delete pages, and zoom
- Export to PNG, JPEG, SVG, PDF, XML and HTML from the command line, covering scale, border, transparency, cropping, page selection with -p and --size page, and PNG and PDF export from the app
- Diagram round trip in an exported PDF, including reopening the exported PDF and recovering both pages and their contents
- Mermaid and CSV import and the --layout and --normalize options from the command line
- Shape search, stencils and shape libraries, the export dialog and the print dialog
- Settings survive a restart
- The macOS bundle is signed with a Developer ID certificate under the hardened runtime, is notarised and stapled, and the Quick Look app extension is sandboxed, separately signed and registered for this build
- The Electron security fuses are applied, so RunAsNode, the NODE_OPTIONS variable and the node inspect arguments are disabled and the app only loads from the asar
- 259 unit tests pass

Updates

- A new install reports no pending update, shows Check for Updates in the Help menu and Automatic Updates switched on in the Extras menu
- When the editor is told that an update has been downloaded it shows the restart notice and the Help menu offers Restart to Update instead of Check for Updates, and an available update for installs that do not update themselves shows the download notice
- Clicking the notice while no update is pending leaves the app and the open diagram as they are
- Switching Automatic Updates off and on again survives a restart each way
- The rules for which install type downloads, links to the release page or never checks are covered by unit tests [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2569]

Printing

- The paper sent to the print dialog is the page format in portrait order with landscape set for landscape pages, and pages are printed at 100% for every page scale, covered by unit tests [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2568] [jgraph/drawio#5540]

Command line

- --embed-svg-metadata adds the properties of a shape as data-meta-* attributes to the SVG, and the same export without the option adds none [jgraph/drawio-desktop#1805]

Core changes checked in the desktop app

- Exports with a scale and a border have the same border on all four sides from the command line, where the right and bottom border were narrower in 31.7.0, and exports at scale 1 or fitted to a width are unchanged [jgraph/drawio#5559]
- Drafts of unsaved changes are saved as plain diagram data, also for .drawio.svg files, and reopening the file offers the draft and restores the unsaved change
- Tall diagrams and Mermaid files open fitted to the window with every shape in view
- Changes made to an open file by another program are detected while the window is in the background
- The image export dialog shows the new presets
- Mermaid files converted from the command line keep the same layout as in 31.7.0, and an empty Mermaid file still ends with an error instead of writing a file

Checks around the changes

- The window background colour in dark mode matches the editor's background
- The functions the app exposes to the editor page are unchanged and give it no access to Node
- Reads, stats and writes of paths the user has not authorised are still refused, while an authorised file still reads and saves
- File and javascript links are still refused rather than opened externally
- Every update manifest names 32.3.0, and the Windows x64 and arm64 manifests each list only their own installer

## Release Notes for 31.7.0

[Windows Installer](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.7.0/draw.io-31.7.0-windows-installer.exe)
[Windows No Installer (zip)](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.7.0/draw.io-31.7.0-windows.zip)
[macOS - Universal](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.7.0/draw.io-universal-31.7.0.dmg)
Linux - [deb](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.7.0/drawio-amd64-31.7.0.deb), [AppImage](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.7.0/drawio-x86_64-31.7.0.AppImage) or [rpm](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.7.0/drawio-x86_64-31.7.0.rpm)

**ChangeLog:**

- Uses electron 44.5.1
- Keeps the diagram open when a link, form or script tries to load a blank page into the editor window, which previously replaced the editor with an empty window
- Shows the keyboard shortcuts in a dialog inside the app, which also works offline [jgraph/drawio-desktop#1130]
- Updates to [draw.io core 31.7.0](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/v31.7.0/ChangeLog). All changes from 31.5.3 to 31.7.0 are added in this build.

**Testing:**

Verified against the packaged, signed macOS build. Windows and Linux packages were verified from the produced release artifacts, their sizes and update manifests, rather than by running them.

Base checks

- Launch, open a file passed on the command line, add and edit shapes, change styles, undo and redo, copy and paste, save, insert, rename and delete pages, and zoom
- Export to PNG, JPEG, SVG, PDF, XML and HTML from the command line, covering scale, border, transparency, cropping, page selection with -p and --size page, and PNG and PDF export from the app
- Diagram round trip in an exported PDF, including reopening the exported PDF and recovering both pages and their contents
- Mermaid and CSV import and the --layout and --normalize options from the command line
- Shape search, stencils and shape libraries, the export dialogs and the print dialog
- Settings survive a restart
- The macOS bundle is signed with a Developer ID certificate under the hardened runtime, is notarised and stapled, and the Quick Look app extension is sandboxed, separately signed and registered for this build
- The Electron security fuses are applied, so RunAsNode, the NODE_OPTIONS variable and the node inspect arguments are disabled and the app only loads from the asar
- 229 unit tests pass

Blank pages in the editor window

- The editor stays open for eight ways of loading a blank page into its window: setting the location, location.assign, window.open with _self and with _top, a link, a form, a meta refresh and a frame changing the top location. On 31.5.3 the first of these replaced the editor with an empty window
- Blank windows opened by the editor, such as the print preview, still open as separate windows with their content, and other addresses still go through the check that only opens allowed links externally

Keyboard shortcuts

- Help > Keyboard Shortcuts shows the shortcut sheet bundled with the app in a dialog [jgraph/drawio-desktop#1130]

Core changes checked in the desktop app

- Transparent PNG export of a diagram with a background colour is now fully transparent from the command line, and keeps the background without the transparency option [jgraph/drawio-desktop#1905]
- PDF export of a page with math contains the formula source as text, image export of a page without math keeps the label text exactly as typed, and PNG export of math is pixel for pixel the same as in 31.5.3
- Math support loads only when math is first used, and formulas render in the editor
- Page animations export as an animated GIF and as an H.264 MP4 video at 1280x720, with the frames following the animation steps [jgraph/drawio#5777]
- Undo and redo shortcuts work while the colour picker window has the focus [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2395]
- Clicking a connector in the shape library with two shapes selected connects them [jgraph/drawio-desktop#1962]

Checks around the changes

- The functions the app exposes to the editor page are unchanged and give it no access to Node
- Reads, stats and writes of paths the user has not authorised are still refused, while an authorised file still reads and saves
- File and javascript links are still refused rather than opened externally
- Every update manifest names 31.7.0, and the Windows x64 and arm64 manifests each list only their own installer

## Release Notes for 31.5.3

[Windows Installer](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.5.3/draw.io-31.5.3-windows-installer.exe)
[Windows No Installer (zip)](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.5.3/draw.io-31.5.3-windows.zip)
[macOS - Universal](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.5.3/draw.io-universal-31.5.3.dmg)
Linux - [deb](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.5.3/drawio-amd64-31.5.3.deb), [AppImage](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.5.3/drawio-x86_64-31.5.3.AppImage) or [rpm](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.5.3/drawio-x86_64-31.5.3.rpm)

**ChangeLog:**

- Opens and saves files on mapped network drives again, which 31.5.2 refused with "path not authorised". Files and libraries on such a drive that were opened with 31.5.2 or earlier need opening once more after the update [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2559]
- Shows tooltip icons again when the retired Tooltips plugin is enabled in the settings, instead of failing to load the plugin
- Command line exports of Mermaid input with nothing to draw, for example statements that are not recognised, fail with "Nothing to draw" and exit code 1 instead of writing an empty PDF or XML file or failing without a reason
- The Linux deb and rpm packages give the licence as GPL-3.0-only, following the licence change in 31.5.2
- Updates to [draw.io core 31.5.3](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio/blob/v31.5.3/ChangeLog). All changes from 31.5.2 to 31.5.3 are added in this build.

**Testing:**

Verified against the packaged, signed macOS build. Windows and Linux packages were verified from the produced release artifacts, their sizes and update manifests, rather than by running them, and the Windows mapped drive fix from unit tests and the same path mismatch reproduced on macOS.

Base checks

- Launch, open a file passed on the command line, add and edit shapes, change styles, undo and redo, copy and paste, save and reopen, insert and delete pages, rename a page, and zoom
- Export to PNG, SVG and PDF from the app and from the command line, covering scale, border, transparency, cropping, page selection with -p and --size page
- Diagram round trip in an exported PDF, including reopening the exported PDF and recovering both pages and their contents
- Mermaid, CSV and Visio import and the --layout and --normalize options from the command line
- Shape search, the menus, the export and print dialogs
- Settings survive a restart, and unsaved changes are kept as a draft next to the file
- The macOS bundle is signed with a Developer ID certificate under the hardened runtime, is notarised and stapled, and the Quick Look app extension is sandboxed and separately signed
- The Electron security fuses are applied, so RunAsNode, the NODE_OPTIONS variable and the node inspect arguments are disabled and the app only loads from the asar
- 229 unit tests pass

Files on mapped drives

- A diagram opened through a path whose spelling differs from its location on disk, the mismatch a mapped drive causes, opens with both pages, reads back, saves without a dialog and gets its backup and draft, where 31.5.2 refused it with "path not authorised" [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2559]
- A library declared in the configuration through such a path loads, and writing to it is still refused

Tooltips plugin

- A profile with the retired Tooltips plugin enabled starts without a failed load and draws the tooltip icon on shapes that have a tooltip, built-in plugins still load, and plugin entries pointing outside the app are skipped

Mermaid on the command line

- Two kinds of Mermaid input with nothing to draw fail PNG, SVG, PDF and XML exports with exit code 1 and the reason, and write no file, while valid Mermaid still exports

draw.io core 31.5.3

- Curved connectors stay curved when their waypoints are set to Straight [jgraph/drawio-desktop#1442]
- The new Orthogonal Ends option shows with its label in the Format panel and applies to the selected connector
- PlantUML sequence diagrams convert with the sequence connector style
- Shape search matches the tags of shapes whose names contain several words
- A Visio file imports from the command line with the same result as in 31.5.2

Checks around the changes

- Reading, writing and checking a file through a link placed next to an authorised file is refused, as are files outside the authorised set, and the files the links point to are unchanged
- Saving still works when the backup file name is a link to a file elsewhere, that file is not written, and a normal backup is created once the link is gone [GHSA-36x5-vw5q-29rv]
- file: and javascript: links are not opened externally
- All menus list the same entries as in 31.5.2 apart from the version

## Release Notes for 31.5.2

[Windows Installer](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.5.2/draw.io-31.5.2-windows-installer.exe)
[Windows No Installer (zip)](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.5.2/draw.io-31.5.2-windows.zip)
[macOS - Universal](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.5.2/draw.io-universal-31.5.2.dmg)
Linux - [deb](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.5.2/drawio-amd64-31.5.2.deb), [AppImage](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.5.2/drawio-x86_64-31.5.2.AppImage) or [rpm](https://github.com/jgraph/drawio-desktop/releases/download/v31.5.2/drawio-x86_64-31.5.2.rpm)

**ChangeLog:**

- Uses electron 44.4.5
- Notices changes made to an open file by another program even when draw.io is not the frontmost application, and sends them to the window that has the file open [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2541]
- Asks whether to overwrite or synchronise when another program replaces an open file with an older version of itself, for example a sync client rolling back, instead of merging it silently [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2382]
- Loads shape libraries declared with a local path in the libraries configuration again, which were refused with "Path not authorized" since 31.4.4 [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2546]
- Adds the --normalize command line option, which repairs generated diagrams before they are exported or opened: edges filed under the wrong parent, edges without a geometry and containers that clip their children
- Adds the --timeout command line option, which fails the export of a file that takes longer than the given number of seconds and continues with the next file
- Command line exports no longer hang or stop at a dialog: invalid Mermaid input, an unknown or invalid --layout, a crashed export or Visio import and an unreadable file now fail that file with an error while the rest of a folder still exports, an unexpected error ends the export instead of showing a dialog, and the exit code is 1 in both cases. Empty Mermaid and CSV files are refused for HTML export
- Skips symbolic links when exporting a folder from the command line, and refuses to write an output file through a symbolic link placed at the file name the export derives from its input. Paths typed on the command line are followed as before [GHSA-2w35-fgjm-2vvh]
- Starts Windows system programs by their full path, so a program placed in a diagram's folder can no longer run in their place when the diagram is opened from Explorer [GHSA-qg46-52fx-h7p8]
- Stops backups and file writes from following a symbolic link placed at the name of an authorised file or its backup [GHSA-36x5-vw5q-29rv]
- Never checks for updates when updates are disabled, including from the Help menu and when the settings cannot be read

- Diagram round trip in an exported PDF, including reopening the exported PDF and recovering both pages and their contents
- Mermaid and CSV import and the --layout option from the command line
- Shape search, the export and print dialogs and the configuration dialog
- Settings survive a restart, and unsaved changes are kept as a draft next to the file
- The macOS bundle is signed with a Developer ID certificate under the hardened runtime, is notarised and stapled, and the Quick Look app extension is sandboxed and separately signed
- The Electron security fuses are applied, so RunAsNode, the NODE_OPTIONS variable and the node inspect arguments are disabled and the app only loads from the asar
- 225 unit tests pass

Changes to open files

- A change made by another program reaches a window that is not focused within 5 seconds and shows the notice to synchronise [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2541]
- Replacing an open file with an older saved version of itself asks whether to overwrite or synchronise, closing the question keeps the notice, and overwriting writes the current version back [jgraph/drawio-desktop#2382]

Command line
